reason: After thorough review of the Churchill Downs Incorporated 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) data was found. The filing contains detailed financial information about the company's three operating segments (Live and Historical Racing, Wagering Services and Solutions, and Gaming), revenue breakdowns by state and property, and various operational metrics. However, the company did not disclose any TAM figures, market size estimates, or addressable market data in this filing. The document focuses on actual financial results, segment performance, and property-level details rather than forward-looking market opportunity assessments.
